login.title: Sign in to your shift
login.subtitle: Enter your shift code and PIN to continue.
login.footerNote: Crew access only — not a customer portal

home.emptyDescription: No vehicles in the queue. Check again in a moment.
home.claimHint: Tap the button to claim a job from the queue
home.claimHintReady: Tap to claim the next available job
home.notifDescription: Get notified instantly when new jobs arrive
home.notifGrantedDescription: You'll be notified when new jobs arrive
home.notifDeniedDescription: Enable notifications in your browser settings to receive job alerts
home.jobTakenByOther: No jobs available at the moment.

job.notFoundDescription: This job may have been completed or is no longer available.
job.timeExpiredHint: Time's up. Request a time extension or ask for help to continue.

staleModal.title: Job Time Expired
staleModal.description: The ETA for this job has elapsed. Please choose an action:
staleModal.requestHelpDesc: Mark job as needing assistance. An admin will follow up with you.
staleModal.markStaleDesc: Mark job as stale. The job remains recorded and admin can reassign it.

incomingModal.title: Job Available
incomingModal.description: A new job is ready in the queue. What would you like to do?
incomingModal.acceptDesc: Claim this job and start immediately.
incomingModal.waitDesc: Skip for now. Job remains in queue for others.
incomingModal.rejectDesc: Decline this job with a reason.
incomingModal.waitingDesc: Job offer paused. You can claim early anytime.

timeExt.confirmDesc: Your request will be sent to the admin for approval. The time extension is not guaranteed.

verify.title: Verify Plate
verify.escalatedDescription: Plate not found. Supervisor has been notified.

beforePhotos.title: Vehicle Condition Photos
beforePhotos.subtitle: Take 4 photos before starting the wash.
beforePhotos.guidelineTip1: Stand 1–2 m from the vehicle — full side must be visible
beforePhotos.guidelineTip2: Face the light source — avoid shooting into the sun
beforePhotos.guidelineTip3: Hold the phone steady to avoid blur
beforePhotos.guidelineTip4: Capture the vehicle only — no other cars overlapping the frame

wash.title: Washing in Progress
wash.subtitle: Wash the vehicle, then tap the button below when done.
wash.hint: Customer can see the wash progress in real time.
wash.error: Failed to update wash status. Please try again.

finish.title: Finish
finish.subtitle: Take 4 photos of the vehicle after washing, then confirm.
finish.error: Failed to complete the job. Please try again.

stale.bannerDesc: This job has exceeded its estimated time. Please wait for a supervisor to reassign or extend the time.

needsHelp.modalDesc: Select the reason you need supervisor assistance.
needsHelp.waitingBannerDesc: Help has been requested. Please wait for your supervisor.
